blocks.title: FAQs
texts: How long does delivery take?
Orders are usually delivered within 3–7 business days. For local delivery, you can contact store customer service to confirm the specific timing.
How do I contact BUZUD customer service?
You can call +65 6518 9979 / +65 6518 9269, email customerservice@chungyip.com, or visit our experience stores in Singapore.
Do you support returns and exchanges?

Repair and exchange services are available both within and beyond the warranty period. In the event of manufacturing or quality issues, you can bring the product and invoice to a store for assistance.
How do I register product warranty?
Visit the warranty registration page, fill in the product information to complete registration, and keep your invoice safe after submitting.
What health experiences do stores offer?
You can enjoy services such as oxygen therapy revitalization, body composition analysis, blood glucose/lipid/uric acid analysis and blood pressure testing. Visit a store to book an experience.

blocks.title: Get help
texts: Our customer service hotline and online agents will respond to you as soon as possible during working hours. Feel free to contact us anytime.
Delivery

blocks.title: Local delivery within Singapore
texts: Delivery fee: SGD 9.9 per order within Singapore, as shown at checkout.
Free-delivery threshold: none at present.
Estimated time: 2–4 business days after order confirmation; remote areas may take slightly longer.
Coverage: Singapore addresses only. Please inspect the package upon delivery.

blocks.title: In-store pickup
texts: Pickup at our three experience stores is available:
· Raffles Hospital: 585 North Bridge Road, #01-02, Singapore 188770
· Novena Square 2: 10 Sinaran Dr, #03-21, Singapore 307506
· PARKROYAL on Beach Road: 7500 Beach Road, Level 4, Singapore 199591
Please confirm stock and pickup time with customer service before ordering.

blocks.title: Overseas delivery
texts: Overseas delivery covers most countries and regions, excluding countries subject to trade sanctions with Singapore.
Overseas shipping is quoted by destination and parcel weight; please confirm the fee and estimated time with customer service before ordering.

blocks.title: Bulky items & special arrangements
texts: Bulky items such as wheelchairs and oxygen concentrators may incur additional delivery fees and require confirmation of floor access and installation; please confirm with customer service.
Hotline: +65 8381 1666 (Mon–Fri 9am–8pm; Sat–Sun 10am–7pm).
Need delivery arrangements? Contact our customer service team.
After-sales service

blocks.title: Warranty period
texts: Electronic products (blood pressure monitors, smart watches, oxygen concentrators, pulse oximeters, thermometers, hearing aids, etc.): 12 months from the date of purchase.
Accessories and consumables (cuffs, power cables, test strips, lancets, etc.): as stated on the package or warranty card.
The exact warranty period follows the enclosed warranty card or product packaging.

blocks.title: What is covered
texts: During the warranty period, failures caused by manufacturing or product quality issues under normal use are covered, with free repair or replacement upon presenting your warranty registration number, order number or invoice.
Not covered: damage caused by misuse, water, drops or impact, unauthorised disassembly, normal consumption of consumables, or failure to follow the instructions.

blocks.title: How to make a claim
texts: Please bring or provide: warranty registration number, order number or invoice, and the faulty product with its packaging.
In-store inspection is usually completed on the spot; repairs that require returning to the factory generally take 3–7 business days, subject to actual conditions.
A temporary replacement device may be provided while repairs are being made.

blocks.title: Out-of-warranty repairs
texts: Paid repairs are available for out-of-warranty items; you will be quoted before any work begins, and no undisclosed charges apply.
Hotline: +65 8381 1666 (Mon–Fri 9am–8pm; Sat–Sun 10am–7pm).
Remember to register your warranty on our website to enjoy official warranty coverage.
Store addresses and opening hours are available on the “Contact us” page.
Exclusive benefits

Welcome to learn about CHUNG YIP's exclusive benefits. Visit a store to experience health monitoring services such as oxygen therapy revitalization, body composition analysis, blood glucose/lipid/uric acid analysis and blood pressure testing. Appointments are welcome.
